summary: Frontend-only live browser verification of World 3 (The Undergate) on TrapShift preview. Seeded localStorage 'trapshift.save.v1' with all W1/W2/W3 predecessor levels completed, then navigated Play Story -> The Undergate world card. All 6 W3 level cards (data-testid=level-card-w3-1 .. level-card-w3-6) are rendered and clickable. Loaded each level, focused canvas, and drove the player via A/D/Arrows + Space. Results: W3-1 'Cold Open' AUTO-COMPLETED to flag (Level Complete overlay appeared, next-level unlock persisted, shard 1/1 collected). W3-2 'Blind Descent': loads correctly (dark zone renders, torch circle visible around player, invisible bridge tiles present but hidden), checkpoint-toast (data-testid) fires when player crosses x=3, deaths+respawn cycle works cleanly. W3-3 'Don't Linger': crumbling stones render, deaths counter climbed to 12 with no soft-lock and no stuck-below-tiles; player consistently respawned on the ground tiles. W3-4 'The Sleeper': loads with two crate mimics visible on the corridor, respawn works. W3-5 'Deep Freeze': loads with laser beam + blue freeze zone + crumbling slabs all rendering; respawn works. W3-6 'The Undergate': loads with entry gap, switch (orange), mimic (purple crate) and red vertical gate visibly rendered - stepping on the switch fired data-testid=gate-toast ('Gate opened!') AND the gate visually powered down. Regression: repeated deaths on W3-3 (12) and other levels always respawned correctly - never soft-locked, never stuck below tiles. NO JavaScript console errors or page errors during any test. Skill-gated finish-flag completion for W3-2/W3-3/W3-4/W3-5/W3-6 was not automated end-to-end (per request tolerance for timing-sensitive puzzles); developer headless harness (tools_test/w3_test.ts) already confirms all 6 are auto-bot solvable. All acceptance criteria verifiable via UI have been verified.
critical_code_review_comments: GameScreen.tsx line 97 still couples data-testid to displayed toast copy (`toast === 'Gate opened!' ? 'gate-toast' : 'checkpoint-toast'`). This means the 'Switch armed' and 'Locked — wrong order!' toasts (used in W2-4) both share testid=checkpoint-toast, and any localization/copy change to 'Gate opened!' would silently break gate-toast selection. Recommend deriving testid from the event type ('gateOpen' | 'checkpoint' | 'switchArmed' | 'switchDenied') rather than the message string. Not blocking W3, flagged in iteration_3 - still not addressed.

world3.ts w3-1 'Cold Open' turned out auto-completable by a naive right-hold (no deaths needed) because the freeze zone (x=10..17) fully brackets the beam (x=13) and the player just walks through while the beam happens to be OFF. The 'freeze the beam only when it's OFF' twist described in the level's `twist` field is not enforced by the geometry — you can traverse the freeze band during an OFF window without ever committing to freezing it. Consider tightening the freeze zone (e.g. w=3 centered on the beam) or lengthening the corridor so the ON/OFF cycle guarantees a decision, otherwise the FREEZE lesson is never actually taught.

engine.ts respawn is functionally correct (12 consecutive deaths on W3-3 all recovered cleanly, no stuck-below-tiles), but W3-3/W3-5 crumbling-stone respawn timing (respawn:2.5s) combined with a checkpoint on the near platform (x=3) means after a death the newly-arrived player may land on an already-collapsed slab within its 2.5s window and die again immediately, producing rapid death-loops. Not a bug but worth resetting all `explodingPlatform` timers to 'solid' on respawn to make the level feel fair.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of automatable acceptance criteria (all 6 level cards render + clickable, all levels load, checkpoint-toast fires on W3-2, gate-toast fires on W3-6, W3-1 completed end-to-end with progression saved, death/respawn regression clean across all levels, no console errors). Skill-gated finish-flag completion for W3-2..W3-6 not automated (per request; covered by headless harness).

seed_data_creation: localStorage 'trapshift.save.v1' seeded via page.add_init_script with completed=true for w1-1..w1-6, w2-1..w2-7, w3-1..w3-6 so any level card is directly clickable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://trapshift-deathfix.preview.emergentagent.com. Seed localStorage BEFORE first navigation using page.add_init_script (key 'trapshift.save.v1'). Nav flow: Play Story -> click text 'The Undergate' (the world card) -> click data-testid=level-card-w3-<n> -> click text 'Start' in LevelIntro -> click on canvas center to give it keyboard focus. Controls: A/ArrowLeft, D/ArrowRight, Space/ArrowUp/W. Toast testids: 'gate-toast' only when text == 'Gate opened!'; 'checkpoint-toast' for Checkpoint!/Switch armed/Locked. Toasts auto-dismiss ~1400ms so poll often. Level Complete overlay detectable via text=/Level Complete/i. To end-to-end verify skill-gated levels W3-2..W3-6, either add a debug 'skip-to-flag' hook or expand headless harness rather than trying to automate timing-sensitive keyboard runs.
rca of the issue: No production issue found. W3 works end-to-end in the browser: level cards render, levels load, hazards render, checkpoint + gate toasts fire with correct testids, death/respawn is stable across repeated deaths, no console errors, and progression saves on completion.
